_about: Scanned trees (Quixel Megaplants, free on Fab) for Ride UK, by the ride's tree kinds (World/WorldRidePlants.cpp). Tools/ue_build_rideuk.py looks for static meshes anywhere under /Game whose path holds one of a kind's words (case, spaces and underscores ignored) and uses them in place of Buttertubs' own models of that kind. A kind with none found keeps ours; oak, beech, willow, rowan, pine and hazel then fall back to ash, sycamore, alder, birch, spruce and hawthorn. There is no Megaplants ash or hawthorn. 'skip' words leave out parts that aren't whole trees; 'most' caps the models per kind.
_enabled: hub, round 143: off. Megaplants whole trees are SkeletalMesh / ProceduralVegetation assets; the only StaticMeshes are leaf, bud and decoration parts, which got planted as trees. Turn on once scanned_trees() uses the whole tree.
